title: Guaranteed Asset Protection Waiver Coverage Financed with an Auto Loan: Cancellation Terms
content:
Waiver coverage financed with a loan of the Auto Loans line is optional. The borrower may cancel it at any time while the loan is open. Cancelling is the borrower's own decision: it is recorded through a cancellation request of the borrower's own, which the borrower confirms.

Each loan receives at most one refund of that coverage. Whether a refund has already been entered is read from the bank's record of entries on the loan, correlated to the loan itself.

## Withdrawn bases

The four bases below governed refunds of this coverage and are **no longer in force**. What is owed on cancellation is settled on the basis now in force for Auto Loans.

1. The basis by which a cancellation made within the product's full-refund window of calendar days after the loan funded returned the whole charge financed at funding, counting calendar days with the day after funding as day 1, is no longer in force.
2. The basis by which a refund after that window was worked out from the charge financed at funding and the months remaining, less the cancellation fee, with no refund where the figure came to nothing or less, is no longer in force.
3. The basis by which a refund was paid to a Piedmont Crescent checking account of the borrower or by official check, and was never applied to the loan balance, is no longer in force.
4. The basis by which paying the loan off early while the coverage was in force was of itself treated as a cancellation dated on the payoff date is no longer in force.

## When the permission stands

The coverage may be cancelled at any time while the loan is open, so a borrower who asks about cancelling shortly after funding and a borrower who asks about it years later are both inside the same standing permission. The once-only limit is on the refund entered against the loan, not on how often the borrower may ask.

superseded_clauses: A GAP cancellation within gap_cancellation_full_refund_days calendar days after the loan funded refunds the whole gap_premium.
The refund is paid to a PCB checking account of the borrower or by official check; it is never applied to the loan balance.

After that window the refund is gap_premium times the number of whole months remaining to the scheduled maturity_date divided by term_months, rounded half-up to the cent, minus gap_cancellation_fee, and no refund is made when that is zero or less.
Paying the loan off early with GAP in force is treated as a cancellation on the payoff date.
